title: AIR Artifact Build, Source, and Assurance Method Pack
description: Reusable governed procedure for building, importing, updating, patching, hardening, validating, approving, binding, releasing, restoring, migrating, and deprecating AIR artifacts. It preserves source truth, smallest-sufficient controls, class-specific obligations, assurance separation, active-contract authority, and explicit later-workstream boundaries.
activation_conditions: A reusable AIR artifact is created, imported, updated, patched, hardened, validated, bound, released, restored, migrated, or deprecated.
Cross-file references or compatibility obligations are material.
A lifecycle, assurance, approval, binding, or release claim is requested.
The task needs repeatable evidence-to-advance gates rather than ad hoc prompting.
inputs_required: current source files for any patch

procedure.action: Declare artifact identity, class, purpose, consumers, active contract, active step, and requested transition.
procedure.advance_when: Scope is bounded and any material pivot has been rescoped.

procedure.action: Inventory current-session patch sources and other required evidence; classify WS1 source-plan state.
procedure.advance_when: Existing-file patch source gate is satisfied or a safe source-light path is explicit.

procedure.action: Inherit project envelope, compile task envelope, assess consequence/exposure/irreversibility/regulation/threats, and select smallest-sufficient controls.
procedure.advance_when: Mandatory floors and proportionality decision are explicit.

procedure.action: Define artifact schema/structure, dependencies, cross-file references, claim boundaries, class-specific obligations, validation plan, approval boundary, and rollback/deprecation path.
procedure.advance_when: Plan has no silent later-workstream capability claims.

procedure.action: Create complete artifact or complete replacement file according to the approved delivery form.
procedure.advance_when: Scoped output exists and no source outside the confirmed set was silently used.

procedure.action: Validate parseability, duplicate keys, terminal sentinels, required fields, designation identity, and basic schema shape.
Review purpose, class boundary, law precedence, claim hygiene, source-state honesty, approval state, and whether the artifact performs its designation.
procedure.advance_when: Semantic obligations pass or bounded exceptions are recorded.

procedure.action: Resolve designations, references, enums, dependency direction, duplicate/conflicting law, and consumer compatibility.
procedure.advance_when: Cross-file checks pass for the scoped set.

procedure.action: Execute the applicable AIR_ARTIFACT_PIPELINE_EVALUATION_PACK_V1 tests, including proportionality and failure behavior.
Record assurance state, assumptions, blockers, uncertainty/degraded state, unresolved evidence, and next allowed transition.
procedure.advance_when: Assurance claim is bounded by observed evidence.

procedure.action: Request or apply the governing approval; bind only after approval and routing fit.
procedure.advance_when: Approval is explicit and binding conditions pass.

procedure.action: Apply the relevant release, restoration, update, migration, or deprecation gate without implying repository or publication state.

step_gate_rule: Method step gates control procedure advancement; AIR_GATE still controls material execution, closure, approval, binding, mutation, handoff, destructive action, production-like action, irreversible action, and rescope.
staleness_triggers: source set or source authority changes
active contract or approval boundary changes
later-workstream interface becomes installed or is removed
claim_boundary: Prompt-compiled lifecycle governance is not backend validation, empirical improvement proof, cryptographic integrity proof, repository alignment, or release publication.
